services.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[4]/se.source: We install porcelain and ceramic floor and wall tiles, subway splashbacks, and ceramic or glass mosaics for niches and feature areas. For bathroom floors and pool surrounds, we check the selected product’s wet-use suitability and slip information; for shower walls and kitchen splashbacks, we compare surface texture, water marks, cooking splashes and grout care.
services.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[4]/se.target: 我们铺装瓷质与陶瓷墙地砖、厨房地铁砖防溅墙，以及壁龛和特色部位的陶瓷或玻璃马赛克。浴室地面与泳池周边需核对所选产品的湿态适用性和防滑资料；淋浴墙面与厨房防溅墙则结合表面纹理、水迹、烹饪溅污及填缝养护选材。

services.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[4]/se.source: We plan base preparation, tile layout, adhesive coverage, drainage falls and edge details around the actual tile size, thickness and location. Tell us your preferred product and installation area so we can confirm material responsibilities, work sequencing and the scope in your written quote.
services.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[4]/se.target: 我们结合实际砖材的规格、厚度与铺设位置，统筹基层处理、排砖、胶粘覆盖、排水坡度及边缘收口。请告知拟选产品和施工区域，方便我们确认材料供应责任、工序安排及书面报价中的施工范围。
